title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
AI Automation Engineer

Up to £70,000 - London

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an AI Automation Engineer to join an innovative technology business looking to transform its internal processes through automation and artificial intelligence.

The business is looking for an engineer who can identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, develop intelligent workflows and integrate AI capabilities into everyday business operations.

This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to work across workflow automation, API integrations, Python development and generative AI. You will work closely with teams across Finance, HR, Operations and Customer Success to understand business challenges and deliver practical solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy and productivity.

You will take ownership of developing and supporting end-to-end automations, combining traditional workflow technologies with AI agents and LLMs to create smarter, more efficient ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

  • Working with business teams to identify manual processes and opportunities for automation.
  • Designing, building and deploying end-to-end workflows using automation platforms and AI technologies.
  • Developing AI-powered solutions using LLMs and APIs from providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
  • Building intelligent document processing solutions to extract and validate information from emails, PDFs, invoices and contracts.
  • Developing API integrations to connect internal business systems and automate data flows.
  • Using AI agents to support summarisation, classification, information processing and business decision-making.
  • Maintaining and improving existing workflows, troubleshooting issues and managing system changes.
  • Working with the wider data and AI team to integrate shared AI capabilities into business processes.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience delivering production automation solutions with measurable business benefits.
  • Experience integrating generative AI and LLM APIs, ideally OpenAI or Anthropic.
  • Strong Python and JavaScript development skills.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, SQL and systems integration.
  • Experience building automated workflows connecting multiple business applications.
  • Understanding of AI agents, prompt engineering and evaluating LLM output quality.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

What's On Offer?

  • Salary of up to £70,000.
  • Hybrid working in London.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and automation technologies.
  • Significant ownership over the development of business-wide automation solutions.
  • Opportunity to work directly with business stakeholders and influence how technology is used across the organisation.
  • A varied role combining software development, AI engineering and business process automation.
